name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Lure of Flames) — 1 Basic — Flame Bolt

system.description:
Pointing at a foe and intoning words of power, the thaumaturge looses a dart of fire that streaks through the air to sear whatever it strikes before snuffing out in a puff of mystic flame.

Casting a Flame Bolt is a single action: challenge your Mental Traits against the target's Physical Traits to hit. On a win the bolt inflicts one level of aggravated fire damage, and a readily flammable target (a pile of hay or papers, though not clothing worn by someone) catches fire. You are not immune to your own Flame Bolt should it somehow be turned back on you. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
